utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday, 10 July. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, we can hear you. More importantly, whose new car is that in the car park? It's taking up about one and a half spaces.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's confidence, that is. Definitely not mine.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Mine's the one with the permanently disappointed-looking bumper.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'm more interested in the heating in the portakabin. July and it's like a sauna in here. Just having a moan, before that goes on your list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We've got the full British summer experience, then. Wet outside, tropical inside.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, before we become a weather podcast. Finished stuff first.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah so, already swapped the filter on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Lovely. Finished yesterday, not something we're carrying into today?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Correct. Crossed off, spanners away.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I tested the fire alarm panel yesterday and it's all fine now. That one's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good, yeah. Nice to have a couple actually off the board.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Also, the shutdown on the boiler safety valve is cancelled now, production need it running. That shutdown isn't going ahead.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, cancelled, not just sliding it into later today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: One observation from me: saw the pressure on the Site Water System dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Recovered without anyone touching anything?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. Just an observation, no work request attached to that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Grace, can you book a contractor to look at the line 3 barrel by the end of the week?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll book a contractor to look at the line 3 barrel. By the end of the week, agreed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's getting the booking made, rather than saying they'll physically be here by then?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. Booking made. We're not promising their attendance by that deadline.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine, I've got that. Contractor booked by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: While we're on contractors and suppliers, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve. That's still blocked on their confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Hang on, is that holding up the lock-out tag-out sign-off as well, or are we talking about the existing isolation?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Existing isolation. I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve this afternoon. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Cal, just so we're clear, you're not treating the unconfirmed delivery as evidence that anything's been fitted?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, absolutely not. It's the isolation sign-off this afternoon, straight away in that slot. Nothing there says the replacement's arrived or been fitted.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, two different things. Got you.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I'll replace the seals on the main water valve by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Callum, that's the seals on the main water valve, separate from the pressure dip Fiona mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, separate job. Mine, by Thursday. Not turning that brief pressure dip into another action.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: There's also the CV01 jam and the sensor check. Those need keeping together rather than losing half of it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the CV01 by the end of the week. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Callum, both bits with you then? Clearing the jam and checking the sensors?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Both with me, yeah. One action, not just pulling the material out and calling it finished.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, I'll chase the purchase order for the turbine one compressor this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thanks, Fiona. Whenever you get a chance this morning; don't drop everything for it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, this morning, but fitting it round things rather than treating it as urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I'll order spare parts for the GT2 bearing next week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, Fiona Doyle against the spare parts order for the GT2 bearing, next week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's me. Next week, not another order I've promised to get out today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Full name. That's when you know purchasing's serious.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Or I've been called into the headteacher's office. Could go either way.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: What about organising the toolbox talk for the team? That still needs an owner.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team by 11am. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, by 11am is having it organised, yeah? Not saying everyone's got to have sat through it by eleven?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, having it organised by 11am. That's what I'm taking on.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Priya, can you update the risk assessment for work on the stretch wrapper next Tuesday? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that on. I haven't got the capacity, and I'd rather say now than nod and let it disappear.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fair enough. Saz, can you take that instead—update the risk assessment for work on the stretch wrapper next Tuesday? Still fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it from Priya. I'll update the risk assessment for work on the stretch wrapper next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good, that's clear. Fairly important, and it's changed hands rather than having two people supposedly owning it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Cheers, Saz. Appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sarah, can you do a site visit at Kestrel with the contractor by the end of the week? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the site visit at Kestrel with the contractor by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just—sorry, talking over you—it's Friday, so no rush isn't pushing that into next week?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, still by the end of the week. No rush as in it doesn't need to jump ahead of the urgent stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Fits within today, without treating it as a drop-everything visit.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And same distinction on the CV01, then. End of the week, but not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll clear the jam and check the sensors; it matters, but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I've got the line 3 barrel booking, too. Booking by the end of the week, not a promise of a contractor walking through the gate today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve delivery remains unconfirmed. Nothing in this chat has unblocked the supplier side.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Correct. My sign-off doesn't change that delivery status.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. And my Line 3 Screw and Barrel filter stays in the done column. I heard line 3 twice and got nervous.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: It stays done. We're not awarding you an encore.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's unusually generous for a Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, all clear from me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good. Thanks, everyone. That's us.
